name: io.github.flow-steward/redisvl
title: RedisVL
description: Search and upsert records in existing Redis search indexes through your own RedisVL MCP server.

instance_host.description: HTTPS hostname for your RedisVL MCP server configured with JWT authentication. Not a Redis database endpoint.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Enter Bearer followed by a JWT from your configured identity provider, with the audience and read/write scopes required by RedisVL. Replace the token when it expires.
